verse: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
hook: When you don't know what comes next
reflection: You don't need the whole map to take the next step. Trusting the Lord means bringing Him into the decision, not only asking Him to fix the outcome.
apply: Pray about one decision before you make it
Write down a time things worked out
Take the next small step today
closing: Which decision are you trusting God with?
caption: Not knowing what comes next doesn't mean you're lost.
